sql: SELECT given_label, family_label, demise_season - nativity_season FROM registry WHERE grip_side IS NULL AND demise_season IS NOT NULL

SELECT r.given_label, r.family_label FROM registry r JOIN netminders n ON r.athlete_pointer=n.athlete_pointer WHERE n.league_pointer IN ('PCHA','NHL') GROUP BY r.athlete_pointer HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.league_pointer)=2

SELECT T1.given_label, T1.family_label, T2.season, CAST(SUM(T2.duration) AS REAL)/COUNT(T2.athlete_pointer) FROM registry T1 JOIN netminders T2 ON T1.athlete_pointer=T2.athlete_pointer WHERE T1.athlete_pointer=(SELECT athlete_pointer FROM netminders GROUP BY athlete_pointer ORDER BY COUNT(athlete_pointer) DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY T2.season

SELECT DISTINCT t1.given_label, t1.family_label, t3.label FROM registry t1 JOIN netminders t2 ON t1.athlete_pointer=t2.athlete_pointer JOIN clubs t3 ON t2.club_pointer=t3.club_pointer AND t2.season=t3.season WHERE t1.demise_season IS NOT NULL AND t1.nativity_nation='Canada' AND t1.role='G'

SELECT DISTINCT t1.primary_label, t3.label, t2.season FROM registry t1 JOIN mentors t2 ON t1.mentor_pointer=t2.mentor_pointer JOIN clubs t3 ON t2.club_pointer=t3.club_pointer AND t2.season=t3.season WHERE t1.athlete_pointer IS NOT NULL

SELECT t1.primary_label, CAST(SUM(t2.duration) AS REAL)/SUM(t2.contests) FROM registry t1 JOIN netminders t2 ON t1.athlete_pointer=t2.athlete_pointer WHERE t1.athlete_pointer='aebisda01' GROUP BY t1.primary_label
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.mentor_pointer) FROM mentors t1 JOIN registry t2 ON t1.mentor_pointer=t2.mentor_pointer WHERE t1.victories>30 AND t2.nativity_nation='USA'
SELECT t1.given_label FROM registry t1 JOIN hall_of_fame t2 ON t1.hall_pointer=t2.hall_pointer WHERE t1.grip_side IS NULL AND t1.role='G'
SELECT victories FROM netminders WHERE athlete_pointer='vanbijo01' AND season=1990
SELECT t1.victories FROM mentors t1 JOIN honors_mentors t2 ON t1.mentor_pointer=t2.mentor_pointer AND t1.season=t2.season WHERE t2.season=1933 AND t2.honor='Second Team All-Star'
SELECT contests FROM tallies_cup WHERE athlete_pointer='broadpu01' AND season=1922
SELECT sideline_infraction, label FROM clubs ORDER BY draws DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(athlete_pointer) FROM registry WHERE debut_elite = '2011' AND grip_side IS NULL
